description: This file defines the SessionsController class in an ASP.NET Core Web API project. It includes methods for managing user sessions, such as login (GetSessions) and logout (CloseSession). It interacts with database context, Redis, and manages cookies, along with auditing actions.

classes.name: SessionsController
classes.description: Controller handling user session management, including login and logout endpoints.

methods.name: GetSessions
methods.description: Handles user login: generates a token, stores it in Redis and cookies, updates last login info, and logs the login event.

methods.name: CloseSession
methods.description: Handles user logout: logs the event and deletes the session cookie.
